name: GetServiceNowAttachment
label: Get ServiceNow Attachment
description: Retrieves metadata for a ServiceNow attachment by sys_id using a stored credential (Bearer token). Optionally downloads the file content.

fields.name: CredentialId
fields.label: Credential (Bearer Token)
fields.description: The ServiceNow access token (OAuth2 Bearer token).

fields.name: AttachmentId
fields.label: Attachment ID
fields.description: The sys_id of the attachment to retrieve.

fields.name: DownloadFileContent
fields.label: Download File Content
fields.description: If enabled, downloads the binary content of the attachment.

fields.name: Response
fields.label: API Response
fields.description: Raw JSON response from ServiceNow API (metadata about the attachment).

fields.name: FileContent
fields.label: File Content (Byte Array)
fields.description: Binary content of the attachment (only if Download File Content is enabled).

fields.name: SizeBytes
fields.label: Size (Bytes)
fields.description: Size of the attachment in bytes.

fields.name: CreatedOn
fields.label: Created On
fields.description: Timestamp when the attachment was created.
